Name: EBAGI - Fancy Artisan Goods Icons EBAGI Pack
Author: Aimon111
Description:
[center][b][color=#fff2cc][size=3]﻿THIS MOD IS FOR STARDEW 1.6 AND ABOVE ONLY! [/size]
[size=3]IF YOU WANT TO USE IT FOR STARDEW 15.6 AND BELOW - DOWNLOAD [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15149]THIS 1.5.6 VERSION FROM HERE[/url]﻿ AND MAKE SURE TO LOOK INTO IT'S REQUIRED MOD DEPENDENCIDES![/size][/color][/b][size=3]
[/size][/center][size=3][center]---------------------------------------[/center]
[center]This is updated 1.6 Stardew version of my [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2080]BAGI[/url] pack to match [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12766]Fancy Artisan Goods Retexture mod.[/url] 
[b]This version of the mod will require [url=https://github.com/chsiao58/EvenBetterArtisanGoodIcons/releases]Even Better Artisan Good Icons[/url], which is the unofficial update for Better Artisan Good Icons.[/b][/center]

[b]Differences from 1.5.6 version:[/b]
[list]
[*][size=3]added retextures for new 1.6 vanilla fruits and vegetables[/size]
[*][size=3]removed Mead retextures (since EBAGI can't make meads look different for now)[/size]
[/list]
[b]Supported mods:[/b][/size][list]
[*][font=Georgia][size=3][url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Starder Valley Expanded[/url][/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=3][url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286]Ridgeside Village[/url]﻿ (only jelly and wine)[/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=3][url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4472]Ancient Crops[/url][/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=3][url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6830]The Love of Cooking [/url]﻿﻿﻿[/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=3][url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5976]Winter Crops[/url][/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=3][url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3568]Lucky Clover [/url]﻿[/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=3][url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4679?tab=description]Sweet Gem Fruit[/url][/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=3][url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13869]﻿Octopetalas[/url][/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=3][url=http://kayainsdv.postype.com/post/10224305]Korea Blossom﻿[/url][/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=3][url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15107]Quaint Living - Flower Garden[/url]﻿﻿[/size][/font]
[/list][size=3][font=Georgia]
[b]Installation:[/b]
[list=1]
[*][font=Georgia]Install  [url=https://github.com/chsiao58/EvenBetterArtisanGoodIcons/releases]Even Better Artisan Good Icons[/url]﻿ (yes, it's github link, download it from there)[/font]
[*]Unpack "Fancy Artisan Goods Icons EBAGI Pack 1.6" mod archive into your "Mods" folder
[*]Enjoy
[/list][/font]
[b]For Octopetalas:[/b]
﻿Octopetalas already have it's own BAGI retextures in it's folder and it will overlap my retextures, so you need to delete it first:
﻿Go to Octopetalas mod folder and delete the "Octopetala Honey and Mead" folder completely.
Most of retextures will apply automatically if the supported mod is installed

[b]FAQ:[/b]
[/size][list]
[*][size=3]there won't be retextures for PPJA (there's too many to do, sorry)[/size]
[*][size=3]some other relatively small mods support will be probably added in the future[/size]
[*][size=3]f you'll find bugs, please tell in the comments and attach your smapi log and\or screenshot of the bug[/size]
[/list][size=3]
[b]Credits:[/b]
[/size][list]
[*][size=3]Used Jelly, Pickles, Mead, Honey sprites from HenrySoftware's free food asset pack  [/size]
[*][size=3]Honeys and Jellies for Octopetalas﻿, Honeys for Korea Blossom are made by Runzu87﻿ (thank you a lot!)[/size]
[*][size=3]Most of the color palletes I used are from all those mods listed above [/size]
[/list]

[/size]
